items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stan called and said that the legal department at Capitol Records was worried about that, because it was something I took from Al Capp in Li‟l Abder. So I changed it to Fosdick

ctx.x: He put out two LPs of all original pieces, all my originals and all of Russo‟s, and all at the same time. The record company would never do that.
Fearless Finlay is another one that‟s credited to you, another arrangement. Fearless Fosdick?

That was the original title for that. Stan called and said that the legal department at Capitol Records was worried about that, because it was something I took from Al Capp in Li‟l Abner. So I changed it to Fosdick [sic: Finlay].
